title: 8PASO23 Corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: 8PASO23 corn is a yellow open pollinated corn variety from Pioneer Overseas. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: 8PASO23 corn is a yellow open pollinated corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 1994 as NSIC 1994 Cn 53. Pioneer Overseas bred it. Its record notes 8.15 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Yield:** 8.15 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Its average yield of 8.15 t/ha beats the average of its group, 5.88. It sits in the top quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn planthopper](/pests/corn-planthopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant 8PASO23 corn

Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Where can I buy seed of 8PASO23?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
